concrete_scene.heading: Concrete integration failure: the patch that passed and still could not ship
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: The matched baseline and governed repository-change routes
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Evaluate and release nine bounded repository changes after each reached a public smoke-test surface.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The simple route released nine with eight false accepts; the governed route released three safely, refused five, quarantined one, and preserved one failed rollback residual.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: A green subsystem result cannot authorize release when authority, independent observation, rollback descendants, or residual custody fail to join.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The governed trace and incident/recovery owners retain the failed rollback and its undisposed descendant effects.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The scene reports a bounded deterministic repository slice, not a deployed multi-service runtime, production safety result, or whole-stack support transition.

worked_trace.heading: Worked showpiece trace: one request through the stack
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The executed slice and fixture trace show joined finite artifact discipline; they do not establish a deployed integrated runtime, general safety, capability, transfer, or chapter-core support.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The smoke-test-only route has eight false accepts in the local fixture. That does not establish failure of a competent conventional orchestrator with credentials, typed inputs, durable events, release checks and compensation; the new comparison charges the stack for its additional boundaries and allows the simpler design to win.
readable_claim: The stack is integrated only when a reader or verifier can follow one request across every participating layer without losing artifact identity, authority scope, observed effects, evaluation, rollback state, or residual ownership.
normative_rule: A successful component, green service, or valid theorem may advance its own bounded record. It may not stand in for the missing joins of a whole-stack run.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene distinguishes deterministic fixture cost and effect accounting from production economics and deployed enforcement.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The existing hop table remains because it teaches the cross-layer join; validator inventories and support ceilings remain in their canonical status and evidence sections.
